title: Three speakers, English, with overlaps and interruptions

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let us start with the budget. We are about ten percent over this quarter.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Most of that is the new servers. We had to buy them early.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Sorry, can I jump in? The servers were planned for next year.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: They were, but the old ones failed in March.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Right, and that is in the report I sent on Friday.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Okay. Then we should move some of next year's money forward.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I can prepare the numbers by tomorrow afternoon.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Great, send them to both of us.
